title: Formal cause connectors: the Bourbon reforms

sections.content: You know *debido a* and *a raíz de* from B1 Unit 6. They give a cause in formal writing and are followed by a noun, not by a verb. They are useful for the Bourbon reforms, where one decision led to the next.

items.spanish: A raíz de las reformas, el rey nombró intendentes para vigilar las provincias.
items.english: As a result of the reforms, the king named intendants to watch over the provinces.

items.spanish: Debido a los nuevos impuestos, hubo protestas en varias regiones.
items.english: Because of the new taxes, there were protests in several regions.

items.spanish: Los criollos perdieron cargos debido a la llegada de más peninsulares.
items.english: The criollos lost posts because of the arrival of more peninsulares.

items.spanish: A raíz de la expulsión de los jesuitas, muchas familias se molestaron.
items.english: Following the expulsion of the Jesuits, many families were upset.

sections.content: After *debido a* and *a raíz de* put a noun: *debido a los impuestos*. Before a verb use *porque*: *se molestaron porque perdieron cargos*. The connector can open the sentence or follow the main clause.
